description: This file contains API utility functions for a frontend application, including methods for HTTP GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE requests, and specific functions for managing work items and comments, with integrated authentication handling.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public, i.e., does not require authentication. Recognizes /auth/login and /auth/signup as public endpoints.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Constructs request headers, adding Authorization if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK HTTP responses, performing actions such as clearing auth and redirecting on 401 errors.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend, returning parsed JSON data or throwing an error; includes auth headers as needed.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON, and handles errors.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returns parsed JSON data.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON, handles errors.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work-item identified by project_id and id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item, including author information retrieved from localStorage and optional display name.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with details like type, title, description, status, priority, and creator info from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for an API path based on the current base URL.
